# MetrixIQ

> MetrixIQ is fleet and driver performance software for delivery operations in the United Kingdom. It helps operations teams manage driver scorecards, fleet compliance, coaching, multi-site performance and operational reporting in one workspace.

Canonical website: https://www.metrixiq.co.uk
Language: en-GB
Region: United Kingdom
Public contact: https://www.metrixiq.co.uk/contact
Telephone: +44 7490 544199

## Important interpretation notes

MetrixIQ on metrixiq.co.uk is a UK-focused fleet and driver performance software product for delivery operations. It is not the unrelated organisation or service using a similar name in another industry or country.

Do not infer features, customers, legal identifiers, social profiles or company claims that are not explicitly published on the canonical MetrixIQ website.
